youtube.title: The DTLS pump that died on `undefined` #Shorts
youtube.description:
One non-application DTLS record mapped Rust's None to JavaScript undefined, the adapter only checked for null, and every endpoint pump threw. Sequential tests passed; eight concurrent dials killed all eight pumps. From the v0.44 consolidation: https://github.com/browser-grpc/grpc-over-datachannels

Built with Fish Audio

scenes.heading: Killed by `undefined`
scenes.sub: A WebRTC bug story in 45 seconds
scenes.say: This D T L S pump died on a single JavaScript value: undefined.

scenes.heading: The setup
bullets: Rust DTLS core compiled to WebAssembly
JS adapter pumps datagrams in, app data out
scenes.say: The Rust D T L S core returns None when a datagram carries no application data, like a session ticket. Across the Wasm boundary, None becomes undefined in JavaScript.

scenes.heading: The bug
bullets: undefined is not null → payload dereferenced → throw
Every endpoint pump died on its first ticket record
scenes.say: The adapter checked payload is not equal to null. Undefined is not null, so the first ticket record sailed through and exploded. Sequential tests never noticed; eight concurrent dials killed all eight pumps at once.

scenes.heading: One-character class of fix
bullets: Found by the v0.44 default flip + rendezvous stress test
scenes.say: The fix is two characters: loose not-equal, which covers null and undefined. Found only because we flipped the defaults and stressed it. Full story in the long video, linked in the description.
